name: healthmon-agent
description: The healthmon Agent (sole signer, value layer).
_comment: fix 2026-09-03 H179: `ai` and `zod` are declared here for all five agents but their call sites are reachable only in spikeagent. src/tools.ts and src/model.ts do import them, and those two modules are imported by no entrypoint in gridtrader, healthmon, rebalancer or yieldopt, whose deliverables are produced by vendor/strategies with no model in the loop. The declaration is kept because the five agents share one source tree; read the dependency list as what the tree can build, not as what the four listed agents run. @aws-sdk/client-secrets-manager is the managed-deploy path only and is unused self-hosted.
